profile_text.body:
Celestica is a public company headquartered in Toronto, and it trades under the ticker CLS. According to its own website, it works in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions, and it describes itself as a technology leader serving high-growth markets. The company says it engineers, designs and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud.

Beyond that self-description, the site says Celestica relies on a global network and a team it describes as talented to help customers pursue a competitive advantage. No specific AI products, lawsuits or other legal matters involving the company are recorded alongside this profile.
